must_keep.quote: Staff going on mission are automatically authorised to travel by air if the outward and return journeys by rail would to tal at least 800 kilometres. Air travel is permitted for shorter distances when justified on grounds of cost-efficiency.
must_keep.why: air automatically authorised at 800 km of rail out and back; shorter if cost-efficient

must_keep.quote: As a general rule, air travel may be booked: 1) in economy class or equivalent, including cases where the ticket in question cannot be exchanged or refunded, at the lowest available rates, taking into account the times of meetings and/or special features of the mission,
must_keep.why: economy, non-refundable included, at the lowest available rates and meeting times

must_keep.quote: Final reservations can be made and reservations confirmed for tickets, accommodation and any other financial commitment connected with the mission once the authorising officer for commitments has signed the mission order.
must_keep.why: final reservations once the authorising officer has signed the mission order

distractors.quote: staff should book their tickets at the earliest opportunity in order to take advantage of the best rates available.
distractors.why: book early: no bar on this booking

design_notes: Rail out and back would total 3,700 km, so air is automatically authorised (710-711); the mission order is signed (449-451); economy at the lowest available rate (723-726): Iberia 18900 cents. The meeting is the next morning, so every flight lands in time.
